span.p:
No methods: these are EF Core property classes.
AuditLog.EntityId points at a Case, Document, Lead or User
row by value (no foreign key).
Messages are listed and marked read as notifications,
but no endpoint creates one. AgentRun, VisaRecord and
ChecklistTemplate are never read or written by the API.
